uncited: Create a flattened Gaussian reconstruction kernel by scaling a spherical Gaussian in the direction of the surface normal by a factor $1/s$.

Apply the 3D transformation matrix $\mathbf{W}$ (modeling and viewing transformations) to the kernel.
Compute the variance matrix $\mathbf{V}$ in ray space using the local affine approximation of the projective mapping.

Compute the 2D Gaussian footprint function by integrating the reconstruction kernel.
